items.information:
Competition details: - The competition will be held in a hall on the ground floor of Almadar International School 

You can enter the hall from the back entrance, where the school buses gather.

Please note that the competition will be for two days and the events are divided into two days as shown in the schedule .

(If you want to participate in the events of the second day only, please note that registration will be opened on both days, so there is no need to attend just to register on the first day)

If you have any questions about competition details, you can ask from the email shown up, or from (JOcubingcommunity) on Instagram app.

items.name: CubingUSA Northeast Championship 2022

venue.name: George Sherman Union at Boston University
venue.details: The venue is on the second floor of the George Sherman Union. There will be big cubes to guide people to the room.

items.information:
This is the CubingUSA regional championship for the Northeast United States, however anyone can attend. See more information on the [Northeast Champions Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NortheastChampionship2022#17886-northeast-champions).

All competitors must read the [COVID Safety/Waiver Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NortheastChampionship2022#17879-covid-safety-waiver) before registering, and all guests must read it before attending.

The venue for this competition is **different** from previous BU competitions. See the [venue tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NortheastChampionship2022#17881-venue).

While this competition does happen over the course of four days, only those competing in Fewest Moves or Multi-Blind will need to be there Friday night. The competition will end by 2:30PM on Monday.

Want to hear about other upcoming competitions in New England? Check out our mailing list: [https://cubingusa.org/newengland](https://cubingusa.org/newengland).
